name: KMRTM28028 TFT (ILI9341, SPI)
description: A 2.8-inch 240 x 320 TFT module with an ILI9341 controller on a 4-wire SPI bus, nine pins in a row: VCC, GND, CS, RESET, DC, SDI (MOSI), SCK, LED (backlight) and SDO (not driven by the model). The model decodes the wires: SDI is sampled at each rising edge of SCK while CS is low (SPI mode 0), D/C tells commands from data, and the pixels written with RAMWR (16 or 18 bits per pixel, windowed by CASET and PASET, oriented by MADCTL) are kept in a memory the bench can read and compare with an expected image. It draws no current. An unconnected RESET is held high by the module.

powered.description: The supply is within the range of the controller (at least 2.5 V between VCC and GND).

displayOn.description: The controller shows its memory: out of sleep (SLPOUT) and display on (DISPON).

sleeping.description: The controller is in sleep mode, as after a reset.

commands.description: Commands received on the bus since power on.

dataBytes.description: Parameter and pixel bytes received on the bus since power on.

pixelsWritten.description: Pixels written to the memory since power on.

unknown.description: Commands this controller does not have.

unsupported.description: Reads of the controller, which the model cannot answer.

framing.description: Chip-select releases in the middle of a byte (SPI).
